findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Objects stored here, including the uploaded vendor roster, are not enforced to use SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS by this Terraform configuration.

The vendor roster object is uploaded to a bucket with no default server-side encryption and has no object-level encryption setting. This leaves the object without encryption at rest enforced by the configuration.
The bucket is marked private but has no server-side encryption configuration. Private ACLs restrict access but do not encrypt ledger data at rest.
The bucket has versioning and access logging, but no server-side encryption configuration. Model artifacts are not protected by encryption at rest enforced through this Terraform configuration.
The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Runbook contents are therefore not required by this configuration to be encrypted at rest.
